## 📝 Description

Please provide a brief summary of what your pull request does and the problem it solves.

---

## 🛠️ Type of Change

- [ ] 🚀 New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] 🎨 UI / UX / Styling polish
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] 📖 Documentation update

---

## ✅ Contributor Checklist

Please verify each item before submitting your pull request:

- [ ] **Up to Date**: My branch is created from and rebased on the latest `main` branch.
- [ ] **Tested on PhysicsWallah**: I loaded the unpacked extension and tested this directly on a live `pw.live` lecture video.
- [ ] **No Shaking or Layout Bugs**: The video player controls remain rock-solid (no elements jumping, shaking, or crowding out other buttons).
- [ ] **Smooth Animations**: Any animations or transitions feel natural and snappy (~0.25s).
- [ ] **Build Check**: I ran `npm run build` locally and verified that TypeScript compiles and the build completes with zero errors.
- [ ] **Changelog**: I added a short, user-friendly entry to `CHANGELOG.md` with my GitHub handle and PR number.

---

## 📸 Screenshots or Demo (Optional)

If your PR introduces or changes visual elements on the player, please attach a screenshot or quick GIF of it running on `pw.live`.
